hook: Naam bhi chahiye aur average bhi? [[Dono milega]]

slides.title: [[PARTITION BY]] dept
slides.note: PARTITION BY = window ko **dept wise** kaato ✂️

slides.title: [[GROUP BY]] vs PARTITION
slides.note: Dono groups banate hain, par PARTITION **rows nahi khaata** 🍽️

slides.title: Ab [[compare]] karo
slides.code:
SELECT name, salary,
  salary - AVG(salary) OVER
    (PARTITION BY dept)
    AS vs_avg
FROM employees;
slides.note: Aarav: **+10,000**, Kabir: **-10,000**. Ek line mein appraisal 😎

slides.title: Kab [[kya]] use karein?
points: Sirf dept ka total chahiye → **GROUP BY**
Kisi bhi aggregate pe: SUM, COUNT, MAX
slides.note: "Har employee ko dept avg se compare karo" = PARTITION BY 🎯

slides.wrong: PARTITION BY aur GROUP BY **same** hain, dono rows merge karte
slides.right: GROUP BY rows **merge** karta, PARTITION BY rows **rakhta** hai
slides.why: PARTITION BY sirf window ka **group** batata hai, output rows same rehti 🪟

points: Har row ko **apne group** ka avg
